item.title: Records tumble as extreme heat grips Australia
item.description: The South Australian town of Marree was the hottest spot on the planet for a day, according to online world temperatures site El Dorado Weather. Photo: Getty More all-time temperature records have been smashed across Australia's interior as a climate change-fuelled heatwave grips the continent.

item.title: Big budget Melania film premieres
item.description: With tensions in Minneapolis still high and a possible US military strike on Iran looming, movers and shakers in the Trump administration took a timeout to attend a lavish event celebrating a big-budget documentary about first lady Melania Trump.

item.title: Weatherston blames 'uncontrollable rage' for killing

item.title: Crusaders too good for Highlanders in preseason clash
item.description: Highlanders winger Caleb Tangitau. File photo: Getty The Crusaders have beaten the Highlanders 33-10 in their preseason game at Fraser Park this afternoon.

item.title: 'Loved by all': Parents mourn daughter killed in landslide
item.description: Sharon Maccanico. Photo: Supplied/NZ Police The parents of a young teen missing after a landslide tore through a Mount Maunganui campground say their "hearts are broken".
